description:
Job Description: Architect – Interior Design & Execution

**Company:** Bludesign Tech Solution Pvt Ltd  
**Location:** Sector 2, Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Experience Required:** 3–4 Years  
**Salary:** As per experience and company standards  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

Bludesign Tech Solution Pvt Ltd is looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Architect with experience in architectural design, interior planning, and execution drawings. The ideal candidate should be capable of translating client requirements into functional design solutions and preparing detailed drawings for residential and commercial interior projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop architectural concepts, space plans, and interior layouts for residential and commercial projects.
* Prepare detailed architectural and interior working drawings, including floor plans, elevations, sections, and detail drawings.
* Create furniture layouts, reflected ceiling plans, partition layouts, and other execution drawings.
* Coordinate with interior designers, project managers, site supervisors, contractors, and clients.
* Review site measurements and ensure drawings are aligned with actual site conditions.
* Prepare and modify drawings according to client requirements and project specifications.
* Assist with material selection, finishes, design detailing, and specifications.
* Ensure design feasibility, functionality, and efficient space utilisation.
* Support the execution team by resolving drawing-related queries and providing technical clarifications.
* Monitor design progress and ensure drawings are delivered within project timelines.
* Conduct site visits when required to verify measurements and resolve design coordination issues.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 3–4 years of relevant experience in architecture, interior design, or architectural detailing.
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture (B.Arch) from a recognised institution.
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD is mandatory.
* Working knowledge of SketchUp and rendering software is preferred.
* Ability to prepare detailed working drawings and execution-ready documentation.
* Understanding of architectural detailing, materials, finishes, and interior construction methods.
* Strong design coordination, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Candidate Requirements

* Candidates should have experience in residential and/or commercial architectural or interior projects.
* Practical knowledge of working drawings and site coordination is essential.
* Candidates should be able to present a portfolio of relevant projects.
* Must be comfortable working from Sector 2, Noida, and visiting project sites as required.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should share their updated CV, portfolio, current salary, expected salary, and notice period.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**About Aeris Communications Inc.**  
  
Aeris is the secure connectivity platform for Physical AI and intelligent IoT devices. It caters to connected cars, drones, autonomous mobility, robotics, utilities, energy, fleet management, logistics, medical devices, and manufacturing. Aeris serves over 7,000 enterprise customers and connects more than 115 million devices worldwide, including 41 million connected vehicles, supported by an ecosystem of 30+ mobile network operators. Enterprises rely on Aeris for the borderless connectivity, embedded security, observability, and proven scale that mission critical Physical AI programs demand.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Qualdev Architect to define and drive quality strategy for complex, data-driven enterprise SaaS platforms. This role focuses on backend, API, validation testing across distributed systems, analytics platforms, and automation-heavy environments. The ideal candidate is a strong quality leader with deep test automation expertise, capable of influencing engineering practices and ensuring high reliability, scalability, and security of modern SaaS platforms.

**Work mode**: Hybrid (3 days WFO at Noida, Gurgaon)

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Architecture & Strategy**

  

* Define and own the end-to-end QA architecture and quality roadmap.
* Drive automation-first and shift-left testing practices aligned with CI/CD pipelines.
* Design scalable quality strategies for distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and datadriven platforms.
* Establish quality standards, governance, and release readiness processes.

**Test Automation**

  

* Architect, implement, and evolve robust automation frameworks for backend and API testing.

**Lead automation for:**

  

* API testing (REST, event-driven systems)
* Backend services and workflows

* Improve test reliability, execution speed, scalability, and maintainability.
* Evaluate and standardize tools, frameworks, and best practices.

* Act as a technical leader and mentor for QA engineers and SDETs.
* Coach teams on test automation, architecture, and quality mindset.
* Partner closely with engineering, product, and platform teams to ensure quality by design.
* Influence stakeholders on quality risks, trade-offs, and technical decisions.
* Lead quality reviews and readiness for releases.

**Non-Functional Testing**

  

* Define and oversee performance, scalability, resiliency, and reliability testing.
* Support production readiness through observability, monitoring, and post-release quality metrics.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* 10+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with 3–5+ years in a senior, principal,or architect role.
* Proven expertise in test automation architecture and implementation.
* Strong product development experience, with hands-on experience validating complex systems.
* Strong programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.
* Hands-on experience with API and backend testing.
* Exposure to GenAI or AI-driven testing approaches.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience driving quality for enterprise-grade SaaS platforms.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Qualifications**

  

* Experience in IoT, cellular, telecom, or network analytics domains.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred).

description:
Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh \| On\-site  
Experience: 6 \- 10 Years  
Employment: Full\-Time  
Company: Solutionara Private Limited  
Industry: IT Consulting \& Technology Services

**About Solutionara**

Solutionara is a U.S.\-based IT Consulting and Technology Services firm with a Global Delivery Center in Noida, India.

As a fast\-scaling consulting firm, we operate with high ownership, lean teams, and disciplined execution. We are also evolving toward an AI\-enabled delivery model, focused on enterprise integration, digital transformation, and scalable technology solutions for global clients.

Our GDC plays a critical role in building high\-impact engineering and delivery teams while driving operational excellence through structured processes and intelligent automation.

**Role Overview**

Solutionara is looking for a QA Lead – Quality Engineering \& Automation to lead quality engineering activities across enterprise application, integration, cloud, data, and digital transformation engagements.

This is a hands\-on QA leadership role. The individual will be expected to provide technical and delivery leadership to QA engineers while remaining actively involved in test strategy, manual/functional testing, test automation, API testing, defect analysis, release validation, and quality governance.

The QA Lead will work closely with Project Managers, Technical Project Managers, Solution Architects, Developers, DevOps Engineers, Integration Engineers, Product/Business teams, and client stakeholders to ensure quality is built into the delivery lifecycle rather than treated only as a final testing activity.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable developing an automation framework, reviewing test scenarios, investigating a production defect, coordinating UAT/release readiness, and guiding QA team members.

**What You’ll Do**

**QA Leadership \& Quality Ownership**

* Own QA planning and execution across assigned projects and releases.
* Define the overall test strategy, test approach, scope, estimates, environments, entry/exit criteria, and quality gates.
* Lead and guide QA engineers across manual and automation testing activities.
* Review test plans, test scenarios, test cases, automation coverage, defect reports, and testing evidence.
* Assign and coordinate QA activities based on project priorities, release schedules, dependencies, and team capacity.
* Mentor QA team members and support development of stronger testing, automation, and analytical capabilities.
* Partner with Project Managers and engineering leads to identify quality risks early and establish appropriate mitigation plans.
* Provide clear visibility into testing progress, defect trends, blockers, release risks, and overall product quality.
* Promote accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the QA function.

**Manual \& Functional Testing**

* Remain hands\-on with functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, smoke, sanity, and end\-to\-end testing where required.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
* Validate complex workflows across web applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and enterprise systems.
* Perform positive, negative, boundary, exception, and data\-validation testing.
* Validate cross\-browser and responsive application behavior where applicable.
* Identify gaps and ambiguities in requirements before they become downstream defects.
* Ensure adequate regression coverage for releases and production changes.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test preparation, defect triage, validation, and business\-user coordination.

**Test Automation**

* Design, develop, maintain, and improve scalable test automation frameworks.
* Identify appropriate candidates for automation based on business criticality, repeatability, regression requirements, risk, and return on automation effort.
* Develop and maintain automated tests for web applications and APIs.
* Establish reusable automation components, coding standards, test\-data approaches, reporting, and framework best practices.
* Review automation code developed by QA engineers and provide technical guidance.
* Improve automation coverage while ensuring automated tests remain reliable, maintainable, and relevant.
* Diagnose and resolve flaky or unreliable automated tests.
* Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and faster release feedback.
* Track automation effectiveness and continuously identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual testing.

**API, Integration \& Data Validation**

* Perform functional and automated testing of REST APIs and service integrations.
* Validate request/response structures, status codes, authentication, error handling, business rules, and data integrity.
* Use tools such as Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, or equivalent API testing tools.
* Validate data across application, API, integration, and database layers using SQL where appropriate.
* Test system\-to\-system workflows, asynchronous processes, interfaces, and third\-party integrations.
* Work with Integration and Development teams to identify failures across APIs, middleware, applications, databases, and external dependencies.
* Validate error handling, retry behavior, exception scenarios, and recovery processes.

**Defect Management \& Root Cause Analysis**

* Own disciplined defect lifecycle management from identification through closure.
* Ensure defects contain appropriate evidence, reproducible steps, severity/priority, environment details, and business impact.
* Lead or participate in defect triage discussions with engineering, product, delivery, and client teams.
* Distinguish between application defects, test\-data issues, environment problems, integration failures, and requirement gaps.
* Perform defect trend analysis and identify recurring quality issues.
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major defects and production incidents.
* Work with engineering teams to ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented where appropriate.

**Release \& Production Quality**

* Support QA readiness across development, QA, UAT, staging, and production environments.
* Assess testing completeness and provide evidence\-based recommendations on release readiness.
* Ensure critical defects and known risks are clearly communicated before production deployment.
* Participate in release planning, cutover, deployment validation, smoke testing, and post\-release verification.
* Support production incident investigation and defect reproduction when required.
* Maintain appropriate traceability between requirements, testing, defects, and release outcomes.

**Quality Governance \& Reporting**

* Establish practical QA standards, templates, checklists, and testing processes appropriate for a growing technology services organization.
* Track relevant quality metrics including test execution, pass/fail trends, defect leakage, defect aging, severity distribution, automation coverage, regression results, and release quality.
* Provide concise QA status reporting to Project Managers, Delivery Leadership, and other stakeholders.
* Identify emerging quality risks early rather than waiting until the end of the testing cycle.
* Participate in project governance and release\-readiness discussions.
* Help standardize QA practices across projects while allowing appropriate flexibility based on technology and client requirements.

**AI\-Assisted Quality Engineering**

* Use approved AI\-assisted tools to improve productivity across test\-case development, test\-data preparation, automation development, defect analysis, documentation, and test coverage analysis.
* Evaluate opportunities to use AI to identify testing gaps and improve regression coverage.
* Encourage responsible use of AI\-assisted engineering tools while maintaining appropriate review, security, confidentiality, and quality controls.
* Explore practical ways to improve QA efficiency without compromising engineering rigor or test effectiveness.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* 6–10 years of overall software quality assurance / quality engineering experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading QA activities or providing technical leadership to QA engineers.
* Strong hands\-on experience in both manual testing and test automation.
* Experience defining test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, estimates, and release\-quality criteria.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Strong experience with functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Hands\-on experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or comparable technologies.
* Programming/scripting capability using Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or another relevant automation language.
* Strong API testing experience using Postman, REST Assured, Playwright API testing, or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of SQL and ability to perform database/data validation.
* Experience with defect and test\-management platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, or comparable tools.
* Understanding of Git/version control and CI/CD concepts.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience troubleshooting defects across application, API, integration, database, and environment layers.
* Strong understanding of defect management, severity/priority classification, RCA, regression strategy, and release validation.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum and/or hybrid delivery environments.
* Ability to work effectively with developers, architects, DevOps engineers, business analysts, project managers, and client stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to balance hands\-on execution with team leadership and delivery accountability.

**Technical Fluency**

The QA Lead is not expected to function as a software architect, but should possess sufficient technical depth to understand and test modern enterprise solutions involving:

* Web and responsive applications
* REST/SOAP APIs
* Microservices and distributed applications
* Third\-party and enterprise integrations
* Relational and NoSQL databases
* Cloud\-hosted applications, preferably AWS and/or Azure
* Authentication, authorization, RBAC, OAuth/JWT, and application security concepts
* CI/CD and DevOps workflows
* Development, QA, UAT, staging, and production environments
* Event\-driven and asynchronous workflows
* Logs, monitoring, incidents, and Root Cause Analysis
* Deployment, release, rollback, and production\-support processes

The individual should be able to understand what is being tested, where a failure is occurring, its likely technical layer, its business impact, and what evidence engineering teams need to diagnose it.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within IT consulting, technology services, or Global Delivery Center (GDC) environments.
* Experience supporting U.S. or other global clients and distributed engineering teams.
* Experience testing enterprise applications, cloud solutions, APIs, integrations, data platforms, digital commerce, PIM/DAM, ERP, CRM, or similar enterprise technology solutions.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or equivalent.
* Exposure to basic application security testing and OWASP concepts.
* Experience with AWS and/or Azure environments.
* Experience with Docker/containerized applications.
* Experience with integration platforms, middleware, Boomi, API management, or event\-driven systems is advantageous.
* Experience establishing or improving QA processes within a growing engineering organization.
* Experience with AI\-assisted development/testing tools such as GitHub Copilot or comparable solutions.
* Relevant QA/testing certifications are beneficial but not mandatory.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means:

* Quality is considered from requirements and design through production, not only during the final testing phase.
* QA risks and testing dependencies are identified early.
* Manual testing is disciplined and focused on scenarios requiring human judgment and exploratory validation.
* Automation coverage grows strategically rather than simply increasing the number of automated scripts.
* Regression testing becomes faster and more reliable.
* Automated tests are maintainable and integrated into delivery pipelines.
* Defects contain actionable technical evidence and are triaged efficiently.
* Critical defects are identified before production.
* QA provides objective evidence for release\-readiness decisions.
* Production defect leakage and recurring quality issues are actively reduced.
* QA engineers receive appropriate technical direction, mentoring, and accountability.
* Project and delivery leadership have clear visibility into quality, testing progress, risks, and release readiness.
* The QA Lead remains sufficiently hands\-on technically to challenge assumptions, investigate problems, and guide the team, rather than functioning only as a QA coordinator.

**Additional Information**

* Immediate joiners are strongly preferred.
* Candidates based in or near Noida Sector 62 (Delhi NCR) are preferred.
* Level 1 of the selection process is an AI\-conducted web interview.

description:
**About Us:**


At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure\-to\-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start\-up. You will find a unique home here.

  

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000\. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

  

Read more about apexanalytix \- https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role**


apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, recognized for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI\-native, Quantum Era\-ready platform to protect over $9\.5 trillion in annual spend.


apexanalytix is seeking an experienced Technology Leader to serve as SVP, Global Head of Engineering \& Infrastructure, based at the company's Global Capability Center (GCC) in Noida, India — building, leading and scaling the GCC as a strategic engineering hub while owning apexanalytix's global engineering and infrastructure platform.


apexanalytix runs its own private cloud: more than 60 Kubernetes clusters across two datacenters, every workload declared in Git and reconciled through GitOps, backed by Ceph software\-defined storage and Cilium eBPF networking, hosted as KubeVirt tenant clusters managed through Cluster API. Beneath it sit Cisco UCS and Supermicro compute, a multi\-vendor network fabric, redundant WAN edge appliances, a large VMware estate and a Citrix tier fronting client access. On top of it run apexanalytix's supplier management platform on .NET, the QubitOn data validation and risk API platform, the Conductor supplier community platform, a Go microservice estate and a React front end.


This is not a lift\-and\-shift into a public cloud. It is infrastructure and software the team builds, owns and operates end to end, from bare metal to the pod to the request. This role owns the strategy and health of all of it globally, while building the Noida, India organization that runs it day to day.


This role works in close collaboration with global engineering leadership, product, security and People Solutions to ensure the GCC operates as a true extension of apexanalytix's technology organization — capable of owning full engineering and infrastructure domains, not simply providing delivery capacity. Past experience building or scaling a Global Capability Center from the ground up is highly valued.

 **Quick Take :**

* Leverages subject\-matter expertise in engineering organization design, platform strategy and enterprise application delivery to advise the executive team on GCC strategy and global technology investment, drawing on the technical leadership bench beneath this role for deep domain expertise.
* Acts as the voice of the Noida, India GCC and internal advocate, ensuring the center's talent, priorities and delivery capacity are understood and supported by global leadership.
* Partners with global product, security and engineering leaders to translate business priorities into GCC capacity plans and technology roadmaps.
* Roles and Requirements
* Organization. Leads the strategic build\-out and scaling of the Noida, India GCC, including org structure, hiring plan, career ladders and location strategy, in partnership with global People Solutions and Talent Acquisition. Recruits, develops and retains top\-tier engineering leaders and individual contributors in the Noida market, building a local leadership bench capable of full autonomy across platform engineering, networking, data and software development. Builds and leads the leadership team beneath this role — Architecture, Software Development and Infrastructure Operations — with clear, non\-overlapping mandates. Hands\-on technical depth sits with that leadership bench — the Architect, the VP, Head of Software Development and Infrastructure Operations; this role hires, directs and holds that bench accountable rather than operating the platform directly. Instills the apex Way and global engineering standards locally, adapting for cultural context without diluting the culture.
* Platform strategy and investment. Sets the strategy and target architecture for the global private\-cloud platform: Kubernetes at fleet scale across bare\-metal, virtualized and managed\-cloud footprints, GitOps delivery, Cilium eBPF networking and Ceph\-backed storage. Owns the investment case for the platform — datacenter and hardware refresh, network fabric build\-out, capacity expansion, licensing and support contracts, and headcount — and defends it to the executive team and, as needed, the Board.
* Datacenter and network direction. Sets direction for datacenter and network strategy across both sites: which compute and network platforms the estate standardises on, site and capacity strategy, and the hardware lifecycle and refresh plan. Day\-to\-day operation — provisioning, firmware, change execution and incident response — is delivered through the Global IT Managed Services Leader.
* Reliability and cost. Sets the reliability and recoverability standard the estate is run to — availability targets, RPO and RTO, disaster recovery posture, and the evidence standard for operational reporting — and holds the operations organization accountable to it. Owns infrastructure cost strategy and the run\-cost target, in a compliance\-regulated context (SOC 2, and FedRAMP/StateRAMP readiness).
* Software delivery. Owns delivery of apexanalytix's product engineering estate through the VP, Head of Software Development, and architectural standards across infrastructure and applications through the Architect — accountable for one standard spanning design, build and run.
* Data platform. Owns the distributed data platform strategy across the multi\-engine production estate, and the geo\-replicated database migration programme — architecture, migration sequencing, tooling and the owning team. Accountable for the database organization having, or acquiring, the capability to run that platform.
* AI\-led engineering. Drives AI adoption across the engineering organization — agentic coding workflows, automated code review, automated issue resolution and the supporting automation library — and is accountable for measured adoption against a stated baseline.
* Governance and partnership. Partners with the CISO on security posture, ensuring infrastructure and applications meet enterprise customer and regulatory requirements. Provides transparent, data\-driven reporting on delivery, cost, reliability and talent metrics to executive leadership and, as needed, the Board. Acts as a key contributor to apexanalytix's overall value\-creation plan, with clear line of sight from GCC investment to EBITDA and margin impact.
* Escalation. Is the escalation point of last resort for a major incident, and the decision\-maker when reliability, cost and delivery speed conflict.

 **The Work :**

**First\-Year Priorities**

* Establish provable backup and restore across every tenant and platform system, with independently witnessed evidence.
* Establish verified high availability across production — replica counts, host anti\-affinity and disruption budgets — applied and checked continuously.
* Complete the geo\-replicated database migration programme with a permanent owning team.
* Build depth and succession in the platform's critical engineering domains, so no production\-critical capability rests on a single individual.
* Drive measured AI adoption across engineering against a stated baseline.
* Establish a single, auditable priority and work\-assignment process across the engineering organization.
* Balance senior engineering capacity across the product portfolio.
* Establish an evidence standard for operational and delivery reporting, in which every status claim is backed by a check that was run and can be re\-run.

**Required Skills**

* 12\+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, including 5\+ years building or scaling a Global Capability Center or offshore development center from the ground up.
* Proven track record hiring and retaining engineering talent in the India market, with strong knowledge of Noida, India/NCR talent dynamics.
* Experience operating in a PE\-backed or high\-growth SaaS environment, with fluency connecting engineering investment to business outcomes.
* Strong executive presence — able to represent the GCC credibly to global leadership and act as a trusted partner to executive peers.
* Experience leading organizations that build and operate large\-scale private\-cloud or Kubernetes platforms — technically fluent enough to set platform strategy, pressure\-test architecture and investment decisions, and hold hands\-on leaders accountable. Direct hands\-on operation of the platform is not required; that depth sits with the Architecture and Infrastructure leadership this role hires.
* Conversant with modern platform engineering practice — GitOps delivery, software\-defined networking and storage, platform services and observability — at the level needed to evaluate proposals, challenge designs and audit operational evidence.
* Credible engineering leadership background spanning both applications and infrastructure — able to engage substantively on architecture, delivery practice and code quality. A prior hands\-on engineering background is valued; recent hands\-on work is not expected.
* Experience sponsoring and governing large, high\-risk platform or data migration programmes — accountable for sequencing, risk and the owning team.
* Demonstrated record driving adoption of AI\-assisted engineering across an organization, measured against a stated baseline.
* Experience with B2B enterprise software, ideally in fintech, supply chain, procurement, or data/analytics domains, is a strong plus.
* Strong communication skills.

 **Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis)**

* Undergraduate degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical field required; graduate degree or MBA a strong plus but not required.

**Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment**

* apexanalytix Global Capability Center, Noida, India.

**Travel required — occasional, including periodic travel to apexanalytix HQ, the datacenters, and other global offices.**

**Scope Boundaries:**

**This role owns how apexanalytix's products and platform are built and run, and the organization in Noida that does it. Security policy, posture and compliance attestation sit with the CISO; AI research, data science and AI/automation delivery with a separate AI \& Automation organization; product strategy and roadmap with the Product Leader; and client commercial relationships with Go\-to\-Market leadership.**

  

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way \- https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

 **Benefits**


At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.


With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

The successful candidate sets architectural direction and standards across both planes — Kubernetes at fleet scale, GitOps, networking, storage, identity and observability on one side; n\-tier application architecture, multi\-tenancy, service contracts and distributed data on the other — while remaining hands\-on with the code and the cluster, and mentoring engineers across apexanalytix's global engineering teams, including the Noida, India GCC.


The ability to reason across the infrastructure and application boundary is the defining requirement of this role. The hardest problems at apexanalytix — and the most valuable ones — live exactly on that line.

 **Quick Take \-**

* Leverages deep subject\-matter expertise in private\-cloud architecture and enterprise application architecture to advise engineering leadership on platform and product strategy and trade\-offs.
* Acts as the go\-to technical authority on how apexanalytix software is built and how it runs, and on the interaction between the two.

* Infrastructure and platform architecture. Owns the architectural vision and standards for apexanalytix's private cloud: Kubernetes across bare\-metal, virtualized (KubeVirt with Cluster API and hosted control planes) and managed\-cloud footprints. Designs and evolves cluster architecture, multi\-tenancy (namespaces, RBAC, admission control, Pod Security standards), and workload placement and scheduling.
* GitOps as the only path to production. Sets direction for GitOps delivery (FluxCD, Kustomize, Helm) through a layered model — component template, shared baseline, per\-cluster overlay — so the fleet's desired state always lives in Git.
* Networking and storage. Defines standards for the Cilium eBPF networking layer (BGP control plane, LB\-IPAM, ClusterMesh, network policy, Hubble) and for Rook\-Ceph and cephadm storage (CephFS, RBD, CSI drivers, snapshots, backup and DR). Contributes to network fabric design, including QoS and buffer engineering on the 100/200/400G data\-plane fabric.
* Platform services. Sets direction for the services the fleet depends on — container registry, identity and OIDC, secrets management, certificate management — and for the Prometheus/Thanos/Grafana/Loki/Tempo observability stack.
* Application architecture. Owns architectural standards across the product estate: a .NET 10 enterprise platform (ASP.NET Core, EF Core, OData, gRPC, .NET Aspire) with a React 19 front end; a Go microservice estate with mTLS and shared contracts; and the supplier\-facing community platform.
* Multi\-tenancy and service contracts. Sets and enforces the multi\-tenancy model end to end — tenant resolution, per\-tenant data isolation, cache key discipline and the identity and access model — across both the .NET and Go estates. Owns service contract architecture: gRPC and REST/OData surface design, versioning, and backward\-compatibility discipline across independently released packages.
* Performance and resilience by design. Owns application performance architecture — data access patterns, large\-column materialization, caching topology and query\-plan discipline — and sets resilience standards including replica counts, host anti\-affinity, disruption budgets, health and dependency endpoints and graceful degradation, applied as a design gate rather than an incident finding.
* Data platform architecture. Owns the architecture of a distributed data tier spanning SQL Server, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, OceanBase, CockroachDB, Vitess, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Snowflake and in\-memory stores. Owns the geo\-replicated database programme — distributed database architecture, migration tooling and sequencing, and the application\-side changes each migration requires — and sets standards for schema change management, index and query design across the multi\-engine estate.
* Internal engineering products. Owns the architecture of apexanalytix's internal product and tooling estate, ensuring it is held to the same standards as customer\-facing products for identity, secrets handling, observability and supportability.

Partners directly with engineering teams to review designs, unblock complex technical problems and ensure architectural consistency.
* Hands\-on delivery. Writes and reviews production code and configuration — C\#, Go, Helm charts, OpenTofu/Terraform, Ansible, Python and Bash automation. This role remains technically hands\-on.
* AI\-assisted engineering. apexanalytix is an AI\-first engineering organization. This role practises AI\-assisted development, extends the organization's automation capability, and mentors engineers into it. This is a core expectation of the role, not a bonus.
* Security and compliance. Ensures the platform and applications meet enterprise security and compliance requirements — RBAC, network policy, secrets management, image signing and scanning, dependency governance — in a SOC 2 and FedRAMP\-readiness environment.
* Mentoring. Mentors engineers across global teams, including the Noida, India GCC, on Kubernetes, GitOps, application architecture and cloud\-native best practice.

 **Required Skills**

* 8\+ years of infrastructure/platform engineering experience, with 4\+ years of deep, hands\-on Kubernetes expertise in production environments at scale — bare\-metal experience strongly preferred, not managed\-cloud\-only.
* Strong GitOps practice (FluxCD or ArgoCD with Kustomize and Helm) and the conviction that Git should be the only path to production.
* Substantial CNI experience with Cilium (eBPF datapath, BGP control plane, LB\-IPAM, ClusterMesh, network policy, Hubble) or comparable eBPF\-based networking.
* Substantial CSI/storage experience, ideally with Ceph (Rook or cephadm): OSD/CRUSH management, CephFS and RBD, snapshots, and performance troubleshooting.
* Experience owning platform services such as a container registry, an identity provider and secrets management, plus observability at scale (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, Loki or equivalent).
* Strong Linux fundamentals (RHEL/AlmaLinux, Ubuntu or similar): systemd, kernel and sysctl tuning, and the storage and network stacks.
* Demonstrated architecture ownership of a large n\-tier enterprise application, not only operating one. Multi\-tenant SaaS strongly preferred.
* Hands\-on .NET/C\# — modern ASP.NET Core, EF Core, and the ability to read and review a production request pipeline. Equivalent depth in another managed enterprise stack will be considered when paired with a genuine willingness to work in .NET from day one.
* Hands\-on Go. A significant and growing share of the estate is written in Go; this is not optional.
* Service contract design experience — gRPC and/or REST/OData — including versioning and backward\-compatibility discipline across independently released packages.
* Distributed and geo\-replicated database architecture experience. Direct OceanBase experience is ideal; CockroachDB, Vitess, Spanner, YugabyteDB or TiDB experience transfers.

* Non\-negotiable versus trainable
